Duke Ulthar the Loved

|thumb|400px|Rostam Riding Toward the History, Adel Adili, CC BY-SA 3.0 (Unported)]]Family: Ducal family of Thring (originator of)

Relatives: Broderick (son)

Ruled: Duchy of Thring (founder)

Deities: Green Lady (ceremonially married to)

Founder of the Duchy of Thring. Builder of Castle Tarengael (16.16).

The bards tell many stories of Ulthar the Loved, but none more often than the one of how Ulthar reclaimed the Green Lady’s shawl from the Steeple of Alberon itself (29.14.14). On his return journey, while sleeping beneath an oak tree, The Green Lady appeared between the eye and the lid and dictated the Seven Laws of Thring that guide the Duchy to this day.

Information

  • He and his son are buried in the Sepulchre of the Sword (15.15).
  • Because of his ‘strange predilections’, he founded the Battle of the Hand (16.16).
  • Like the paladins, the Duke was married to the Green Lady.
  • Ulthar’s horse was named Telamar and can still be found today (16.16.04).
  • Duke Ulthar the Loved was killed by his own son (15.15).

Hooks

  • Why was Ulthar called the “Loved?”
  • What role does the Green Lady play in Thring? What is the importance of her shawl?
